purpose: Document first-party local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Reviewed public official Abia property-service pages and the Ministry of Lands & Housing service listing. The state property workflow is an application interface, not an anonymous public map; registration steps ask for property/land references and identity/title documents. GIS mapping/survey is provided on request after submission of a survey plan and proof of ownership. No coordinates, owner records or private application endpoints were queried. No public parcel geometry route or viewer JavaScript was exposed by the reviewed pages. Whether Abia maintains an unpublished or authenticated city-level parcel GIS that covers the ranked WUP locator; whether any public vector service is available upon request.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Abia State Government services catalog: property registration, certificate-of-occupancy, land use charges and transfer services; responsible agency shown as Ministry of Lands and Survey.
Official registration workflow requests property address/land reference and advances through identity and document steps; not a public parcel viewer. No application was submitted.
Official Abia Ministry of Lands & Housing describes title registration and GIS mapping/survey services, requiring ownership/survey documentation.
